title: Directed differentiation of human pluripotent stem cells to epicardial-derived fibroblasts
protocol: Pipette 32 mL of D-MEM/F-12 medium into a 50 mL conical tube.
Obtain tissue culture plates to be coated.
Take up 1 mL of D-MEM/F-12 medium and pipette to mix with the single Matrigel solution aliquot until thawed (∼10–30 s).
Return all contents to the conical tube.
Mix the Matrigel solution using a 10 mL pipette.
Add 1 mL of Matrigel solution to each well of the 6-well plate.
Add 0.5 mL per well to 12-well plates, etc.
If storing the plates for more than 3 days, add extra D-MEM/F-12 so plates do not dry out.
Suggest adding 1–2 mL of D-MEM/F-12 every 3–7 days to prevent the Matrigel wells from drying out.
Place the plate in the incubator (37°C, 5% CO2, humidified).
Move the plate in 3 quick, short, back-and-forth and side-to-side motions.
Incubate the Matrigel-coated plate for at least 1 hour prior to use.
Store Matrigel-coated plates in the incubator (37°C, 5% CO2, humidified) for up to 2 weeks.
Inspect Matrigel-coated plates for dry spots and discard affected wells if present.
Transfer 32 mL of sterile water to a conical tube.
Add 160 μL gelatin solution to the conical tube.
Mix the gelatin solution using a 10 mL pipette.
Add 1 mL of gelatin solution to each well of a 6-well plate.
Add 0.5 mL per well for 12-well plates, etc.
Add 1–2 mL of sterile water if storing plates for more than a day.
Transfer the plate to the incubator (37°C, 5% CO2, humidified).
Move the plate in 3 quick, short, back-and-forth and side-to-side motions.
Aspirate the gelatin solution from the plate.
Leave the lid off the plate for 2–3 hours in the sterile biosafety cabinet.
Warm mTeSR1 medium at 15°C–25°C for approximately 30 minutes.
Remove a Matrigel-coated 6 well plate from the incubator.
Transfer 5 mL of mTeSR1 to a 15 mL conical tube.
Transfer 10 mL of mTeSR1 to another 15 mL conical tube.
Add 10 μL of 5 mM Y27632 (ROCK inhibitor, final concentration of 5 μM) to the mTeSR1.
Remove a frozen cell cryotube from liquid nitrogen and immerse in a 37°C water bath without submerging the cap.
Swirl the cryotube gently for 2–3 minutes until completely thawed.
Spray the cryotube with 70% ethanol and move it into a tissue culture hood.
Transfer cells from the cryotube to a sterile 15 mL conical tube containing 5 mL of mTeSR1 medium.
Centrifuge the cells at 200 × g for 5 minutes at 15°C–25°C.
Label the Matrigel-coated plate with hPSC line, passage number, date frozen and thawed, and initials.
Aspirate supernatant from the conical tube and wells of the Matrigel-coated plate.
Resuspend cell pellet in 10 mL of mTeSR1 medium containing 5 μM Y27632.
Add 1.5 mL of cell suspension into each well of a Matrigel-coated 6 well plate.
Return the plate to the 37°C, 5% CO2 incubator.
Move the plate in 3 quick, short, back-and-forth and side-to-side motions to evenly disperse the cells across the surface of the wells.
Warm LaSR medium at 15°C–25°C for 30 min.
Remove a Matrigel-coated or gelatin-coated 12 well plate from the incubator.
Transfer 5 mL of LaSR medium to a 15 mL conical tube.
Transfer 12 mL of LaSR to another 15 mL conical tube.
For CPCs, add 12 μL of 5 mM Y27632 (ROCK inhibitor, final concentration of 5 μM) to the 12 mL LaSR medium.
For thawing EpiCs, add 12 μL of 5 mM Y27632 and 0.6 μL of 10 mM A83-01 to the 12 mL LaSR medium (final concentrations of 5 μM ROCK inhibitor and 0.5 μM TGFβ inhibitor).
Optional: Add 120 μL FBS to the medium for EpiCs (final concentration of 1% (vol/vol) FBS).
Remove a frozen cryotube of CPCs or EpiCs from liquid nitrogen storage.
Immerse the cryotube in a 37°C water bath without submerging the cap.
Swirl the cryotube gently for 2–3 min until the contents are completely thawed.
Spray the cryotube with 70% (vol/vol) ethanol and transfer it into a tissue culture hood.
Use a sterile 1 mL pipette to gently transfer the cells into a sterile 15 mL conical tube containing 5 mL of warmed LaSR medium prepared in step 4c.
Centrifuge the cells at 200 × g for 5 min at 15°C–25°C.
Label plate with hPSC line, hPSC passage number, date thawed, date frozen, and initials.
When thawing EpiCs, also record the EpiC passage number.
Aspirate the supernatant from the conical tube.
Aspirate the liquid from the wells of the fresh Matrigel or gelatin-coated plate.
Resuspend the cell pellet in the medium prepared in step 4d.
Slowly add 1 mL of the cell suspension into each well of the 12 well Matrigel or gelatin-coated plates.
Return the plate to the 37°C, 5% CO2 incubator.
Move the plate in 3 quick, short, back-and-forth and side-to-side motions to disperse the cells across the surface of the wells.
Warm FibroGRO medium at 15°C–25°C for 30 min.
Obtain a 6 well tissue culture plate (uncoated).
Transfer 5 mL of FibroGRO to a 15 mL conical tube.
Immerse the cryotube in a 37°C water bath without submerging the cap.
Swirl the cryotube gently until the contents are completely thawed.
Spray the cryotube with 70% ethanol and transfer it into a tissue culture hood.
Gently transfer the cells into a sterile 15 mL conical tube containing 5 mL of warmed FibroGRO medium.
Centrifuge the cells at 200 × g for 5 min at 15°C–25°C.
Label plate with hPSC line, hPSC passage number, EpiC passage number, EpiC-FB passage number, date thawed, date frozen, and initials.
Aspirate and discard the supernatant from the conical tube.
Resuspend the cell pellet in 12 mL of FibroGRO.
Slowly add 2 mL of the cell suspension into each well of the 6 well tissue culture plate (uncoated).
Transfer the plate to the 37°C, 5% CO2 incubator.
Move the plate in 3 quick, short, back-and-forth and side-to-side motions to disperse the cells across the surface of the wells.
Prepare freezing medium: mix 10% DMSO, 30% FBS, and 60% medium supplemented with 5 μM Y27632.
Label cryotubes with hPSC line, cell type, passage number, freezing date, initials, and number of cells/cryotube.
Treat wells to be frozen with Accutase until cells are singularized and lifted.
Add 1 ml of Accutase per well for a 6-well plate or 0.5 ml of Accutase per well for a 12-well plate.
Incubate the plate at 37°C, 5% CO2 for 5-7 minutes for hPSCs, 10-30 minutes for CPCs, and 5-10 minutes for EpiCs and EpiC-FBs.
Prepare quench solution by mixing medium to Accutase in a 1:1 volume ratio.
After cells have begun to lift off the plate, pipette up and down with a 1 mL pipette to singularize the cells.
Transfer Accutase-lifted cell solution to the conical tube containing the quench medium.
Count the total number of cells in the conical using a hemocytometer.
Centrifuge the cells at 200 × g for 5 min at 15°C–25°C.
Aspirate supernatant from the conical tube.
Resuspend the cell pellet at the desired concentration in freezing medium, ensuring there is 1 mL of freezing medium per cryotube.
Quickly aliquot the resuspended cells into cryotubes.
Quickly cap all freezing cryotubes and transfer them into the Mr Frosty freezing container without fully tightening the cap.
Chill the Mr Frosty freezing container in −80°C freezer for 8–24 hours.
Move all cryotubes to liquid nitrogen storage the next day.
Warm mTeSR1 between 15°C–25°C for approximately 30 min daily.
Aspirate the medium from each well of the 6 well plate and replace it with 2 mL of fresh warmed mTeSR1 medium.
Repeat this medium replacement daily until cells are ready for passage.
Warm Versene and mTeSR1 between 15°C–25°C for approximately 30 min before passaging.
Obtain a Matrigel-coated 6 well plate.
Aspirate the medium from a single well of a 6 well plate of hPSCs and add 1 mL of warmed Versene.
Incubate the plate at 37°C, 5% CO2 for approximately 5 min.
Transfer 10 mL of mTeSR1 to a 15 mL conical tube.
Aspirate the Versene.
Using a P1000, remove 1 mL of mTeSR1 from the conical tube containing mTeSR1 medium prepared in step 8d.
Dispense the mTeSR1 medium over the surface of the plate well with the pipette tip perpendicular to the surface until all colonies are detached (∼2–3 washes).
Transfer the contents of the single well into a sterile conical tube containing 10 mL of mTeSR1.
Aspirate the liquid from a fresh 6-well Matrigel-coated plate.
Gently mix the conical contents using a 10 mL pipette.
Seed 1.5 mL of cell suspension into each well of a Matrigel-coated plate.
Adjust split ratio based on colony morphology and spacing.
Increase split ratio if colonies are overly dense with diameter >500 μm and spacing <10 μm.
Decrease split ratio if colonies are sparse with diameter <50 μm and spacing >500 μm.
Maintain split every 3–5 days for optimal cell quality.
Return the plate to the incubator after plating cells.
Move the plate in 3 quick, short, back-and-forth and side-to-side motions to disperse cells evenly.
Monitor hPSC colonies constantly for spontaneous differentiation.
Check hPSC colonies for changes in colony morphology.
Observe large changes in growth rate of hPSC colonies.
Thaw a new cryotube of hPSCs if spontaneous differentiation occurs.
Perform colony picking or obtain a new cryotube of hPSCs from commercial sources if the problem is consistent across multiple banked cryotubes.
Obtain new Matrigel and mTeSR1 stocks if the issue persists across multiple hPSC lines.
Warm mTeSR1 at 15°C–25°C for approximately 30 min.
Aspirate the medium from each well of hPSCs cultured on Matrigel-coated 6 well plates in mTeSR1 medium.
Add 1 ml of Accutase to 5 wells of a 6 well plate.
Incubate the plate at 37°C, 5% CO2 until cells are suspended, approximately 5 min.
Prepare the quench medium by adding 5 ml of mTeSR1 to a conical tube.
Transfer all of the cell suspensions from the Accutase solution to the conical tube containing mTeSR1.
Count the total cell number in the conical tube using a hemocytometer.
Centrifuge the cells at 200 × g for 5 min at 15°C–25°C.
Prepare the plating medium by adding 27 mL of mTeSR1 with 27 μL of 5 mM Y27632 (ROCK inhibitor, final concentration of 5 μM) in a conical tube.
Obtain a 12 well Matrigel-coated plate and label it with hPSC line, “Cardiac”, “Day -2”, seeding density, hPSC passage number, date, and initials.
Aspirate liquid from a fresh Matrigel-coated plate.
Add 2 mL of mTeSR1 with 5 μM Y27632 to each well using the plating medium prepared previously.
After centrifuging the cell suspension, aspirate the supernatant from the conical tube.
Resuspend the cell pellet in mTeSR1 with 5 μM Y27632 at a density of 1 million cells per 100 μL using the plating medium prepared in step 9i.
Add the corresponding volume of cell suspension to each well. For 1 million cells, add 100 μL.
Return the plate to the 37°C, 5% CO2 incubator after plating the cells.
Move the plate in 3 quick, short, back-and-forth and side-to-side motions.
Warm mTeSR1 at 15°C–25°C for approximately 30 min.
Aspirate the medium from each well of the 12 well plate.
Add 2 mL of mTeSR1 to each well.
Return the plate to the 37°C, 5% CO2 incubator.
Warm RPMI/B27 minus insulin medium at 15°C–25°C for approximately 30 min.
Prepare a conical tube with 25 mL of RPMI/B27 minus insulin.
Add 5.55 μL of 36 mM CHIR99021 to the conical tube (final concentration of 8 μM).
Aspirate the previous medium from each well of the 12 well plate.
Add 2 mL of RPMI/B27 minus insulin with CHIR99021 to each well.
Record the time when RPMI/B27 minus insulin with CHIR99021 is added.
Aspirate the medium from each well of the 12-well plate after 24 hours.
Replace aspirated medium with 2 mL of warmed RPMI/B27 minus insulin.
Return the plate to the 37°C, 5% CO2 incubator.
Warm RPMI/B27 minus insulin at 15°C–25°C for approximately 30 min on Day 3.
Prepare a conical tube with 12.5 mL of fresh RPMI/B27 minus insulin medium.
Add 25 μL of 5 mM IWP2 to the medium in the conical tube (final concentration 5 μM).
Collect 12.5 mL of conditioned medium from induced cells and add it to the prepared conical tube.
Mix the combined medium containing IWP2 thoroughly.
Gently rock the plate back and forth before aspiration to suspend cell debris.
Aspirate remaining medium carefully, ensuring all debris is removed.
Add 2 mL of combined medium containing IWP2 to each well of the 12-well plate.
Return cells to the 37°C, 5% CO2 incubator.
Aspirate the medium from each well of the 12 well plate.
Add warmed RPMI/B27 minus insulin at a volume of 2 mL per well.
If there is a large amount of cell debris, wash each well with 1 mL DPBS prior to adding fresh medium.
Return the plate to the 37°C, 5% CO2 incubator.
Warm LaSR medium at 15°C–25°C for approximately 30 minutes.
Remove a gelatin-coated or Matrigel-coated 6 well plate from the 37°C, 5% CO2 incubator.
Ensure that gelatin-coated plates have dried completely before replating.
Prepare plating medium by adding 13 mL of LaSR basal medium and 13 μL of 5 mM Y27632 (final concentration 5 μM).
Aspirate the medium from a single well of a 12-well plate.
Add 0.5 mL of Accutase to the well.
Incubate the plate at 37°C for 10–30 minutes, gently agitating every 5 minutes.
Transfer the cell suspension from the well to a conical tube containing 0.5 mL of LaSR medium using a P1000 pipette.
Pipette the cell suspension on the plate to singularize cells and detach any remaining cells from the plate.
Count the total cell number in the conical tube using a hemocytometer.
Centrifuge the cells at 200 × g for 5 minutes at 15°C–25°C.
Add 2 mL of plating medium to each well of a 6-well plate.
Label the 6-well plate with hPSC line, hPSC passage number, date, and initials.
Aspirate the supernatant from the conical tube after centrifuging the cell suspension.
Resuspend the cell pellet in plating medium at a density of 1 million cells per 100 μL.
Add 300k cells to each well of the 6-well plate.
Return the plate to the 37°C, 5% CO2 incubator after plating the cells.
Move the plate in three quick, short, back-and-forth and side-to-side motions to disperse the cells evenly across the surface of the wells.
Warm LaSR medium at 15°C–25°C for approximately 30 minutes on Day 7 and Day 8.
Prepare differentiation medium by adding 12.5 mL of LaSR and 1.04 μL of 36 mM CHIR99021 to a conical tube, resulting in a final concentration of 3 μM.
Aspirate the medium from each well on Day 7 and Day 8.
Add 2 mL of LaSR supplemented with CHIR99021 to each well.
Return the plate to the 37°C, 5% CO2 incubator after adding the differentiation medium.
Warm LaSR medium at 15°C–25°C for approximately 30 minutes on Day 9, Day 10, and Day 11.
Aspirate the medium from each well on Day 9, Day 10, and Day 11.
Add 2 mL of LaSR to each well on Day 9, Day 10, and Day 11.
Return the plate to the 37°C, 5% CO2 incubator after adding the fresh medium.
Warm LaSR at 15°C–25°C for approximately 30 min.
Remove gelatin-coated or Matrigel-coated plates from the incubator and ensure they are completely dried if using gelatin-coated plates.
Prepare plating medium by adding 12.5 mL of LaSR, 12.5 μL of Y27632 (final concentration 5 μM), and 0.625 μL of A83-01 (TGFβ inhibitor, final concentration 0.5 μM) to a 15 mL conical tube.
Optionally add 125 μL of FBS to the plating medium for increased viability and attachment of EpiCs.
Remove Day 12 EpiCs from the incubator, aspirate medium from 2 wells, and add 1 mL Accutase to those wells.
Incubate the plate for 8 min at 37°C, 5% CO2.
Prepare quenching medium by adding 2 mL of LaSR medium to a 15 mL conical tube.
Collect cell suspension from 2 wells and pool in the conical tube using a P1000.
Centrifuge the cells at 200 × g for 5 min at 15°C–25°C.
Label 6 well Matrigel-coated or gelatin-coated plate with hPSC line, hPSC passage number, date, “EpiC P1”, and initials.
Aspirate supernatant from the conical tube.
Add 12.5 mL of prepared plating medium to the cell pellet using a 10 mL pipette and resuspend the cells.
Transfer 2 mL of the cell suspension to each well of the 6 well plate.
Move the plate in 3 quick, short, back-and-forth and side-to-side motions to disperse the cells evenly across the surface of the wells.
Warm LaSR medium at 15°C–25°C for approximately 30 min daily.
Prepare EpiC maintenance medium by mixing 50 mL of LaSR medium and 2.5 μL of 10 mM A83-01 (TGFβ inhibitor, final concentration of 0.5 μM).
Aspirate medium from each well daily.
Add 1 mL of LaSR medium supplemented with A8301 to each well of the 6 well plate.
Return the plate to the 37°C, 5% CO2 incubator after plating the cells or adding maintenance medium.
Prepare a conical tube with 6.25 mL of LaSR medium supplemented with 0.31 μL of A83-01 (TGFβ inhibitor, final concentration 0.5 μM).
Add 62.5 μL of FBS to the medium (final concentration of 1% (vol/vol) FBS).
Aspirate the medium from confluent wells.
Add 1 mL of warmed Versene to 2 wells.
Incubate the plate at 37°C, 5% CO2 for 8 min.
Adjust Accutase incubation time based on visual observation of the detachment process.
Aspirate Versene from the plate.
Take 1 mL of medium out of the conical tube prepared in step 21c using a P1000 pipette.
Dispense the medium over the surface of the plate with the tip perpendicular to the plate until all colonies are detached (∼2–3 washes).
Pipette vigorously to disperse cells since EpiCs tend to detach in clumps.
Pool contents from all wells into the conical tube containing medium.
Aspirate remaining liquid from a fresh Matrigel-coated plate or obtain a fresh gelatin-coated plate.
Gently mix the conical tube contents 5–10 times using a 10 mL pipette.
Seed 1 mL of cell suspension into each well of a Matrigel-coated or gelatin-coated 6 well plate.
Return the plate to the 37°C, 5% CO2 incubator after plating cells.
Move the plate in 3 quick, short, back-and-forth and side-to-side motions to disperse cells across the surface of the wells.
Warm LaSR at 15°C–25°C for approximately 30 min.
Prepare medium by adding 5 μL of 0.1 mg/mL bFGF (final concentration of 10 ng/mL) to 50 mL of LaSR.
Aspirate medium from EpiCs.
Treat EpiCs with 1 mL of LaSR medium containing 10 ng/mL bFGF daily.
Return the plate to the 37°C, 5% CO2 incubator.
Warm FibroGRO medium containing 2% (vol/vol) FBS at 15°C–25°C for approximately 30 min.
Add 1 mL of Accutase to one well of a 6 well plate of day 10 EpiC-FB cells.
Incubate at 37°C, 5% CO2 for 10 min.
Prepare quenching medium by adding 1 mL of FibroGRO medium containing 2% (vol/vol) FBS to a conical tube.
Harvest Accutase cell suspensions using a P1000 and combine the Accutase cell suspension with the quench medium.
Centrifuge the cells at 200 × g for 5 min at 15°C–25°C.
Label a 6 well tissue culture plate (uncoated) with hPSC line, hPSC passage number, EpiC passage number, EpiC-FB passage number, date, and initials.
Aspirate the supernatant from the conical tube.
Resuspend the cell pellet in 12 mL of FibroGRO medium containing 2% (vol/vol) FBS using a 10 mL pipette.
Transfer 2 mL of cell solution to each well of an uncoated 6 well tissue culture plate.
Return the plate to the 37°C, 5% CO2 incubator after plating the cells.
Move the plate in 3 quick, short, back-and-forth and side-to-side motions to disperse the cells across the surface of the wells.
Warm FibroGRO medium containing 2% (vol/vol) FBS at 15°C–25°C for approximately 30 min.
If cells are below 70%–80% confluent, aspirate the medium and add 2 mL of FibroGRO medium containing 2% (vol/vol) FBS to each well every 2 days.
Immunostain H9 EpiC-FBs for vimentin using Cat#IC2105G.
Add Hoechst nuclear counterstain to the cells.
Incubate cells in FibroGRO containing 2% (vol/vol) FBS for 3 days.
Incubate cells in FibroGRO without FBS for 3 days.
Incubate cells in FibroGRO without FBS with 0.5 μM A83-01 for 3 days.
Incubate cells in FibroGRO without FBS, supplemented with 10% (vol/vol) knockout serum replacement for 3 days.
Incubate cells in RPMI medium for 3 days.
Incubate cells in RPMI containing 2% (vol/vol) B27 with insulin supplement for 3 days.
Incubate cells in RPMI with 2% (vol/vol) B27, insulin supplement and 10 ng/mL bFGF for 3 days.
Incubate cells in RPMI with 5 μg/mL insulin, 10 ng/mL bFGF, and 3.75% (vol/vol) GlutaMAX for 3 days.
Incubate cells in RPMI with 2% (vol/vol) B27, insulin supplement and 3.75% (vol/vol) GlutaMAX for 3 days.
Incubate cells in RPMI containing 10 ng/mL bFGF and 5 μg/mL insulin for 3 days.
Incubate cells in RPMI with 10% (vol/vol) knockout serum for 3 days.
Incubate cells in RPMI+GlutaMAX for 3 days.
Aspirate medium from the 96 well immunofluorescence plate.
Fix cells by adding 50 μL of 4% PFA to each well and incubate at 15°C–25°C for 10 min.
Alternatively, fix by adding 50 μL of ice-cold methanol to each well and incubating for 5 min at 15°C–25°C.
Aspirate PFA or methanol solution from the cells.
Add 50 μL/well DPBS for storage at 4°C if desired.
Seal plates with Parafilm for short-term storage.
Add 50 μL of blocking solution to each well.
Incubate the plates for 1 h at 15°C–25°C or overnight at 4°C.
Prepare primary antibody solutions by diluting antibodies in the blocking buffer.
Treat all wells with the same amount of primary antibody solution.
Aspirate the blocking solution after incubation.
Add 50 μL of primary antibody solution to each well.
Incubate plates for 1 h at 15°C–25°C or overnight at 4°C.
Stain with conjugated antibodies simultaneously as secondary antibodies.
Wash each well three times with >50 μL DPBS after incubation.
Prepare secondary antibody solutions by diluting in the blocking buffer.
Aspirate the DPBS wash.
Add 50 μL of secondary antibody solution to each well.
Incubate in the dark at 15°C–25°C for 1 h or 4°C for 8–24 h.
Aspirate the antibody solution.
Wash each well with >50 μL of DPBS.
Add 50 μL of Hoechst solution to each well.
Incubate in the dark at 15°C–25°C for 5 min.
Aspirate the Hoechst solution.
Add 50 μL DPBS to each well to prevent drying out.
Image on a fluorescence microscope.
Singularize cells using Accutase to detach the cells from the substrate.
Incubate undifferentiated hPSCs in Accutase for 5 min at 37°C, 5% CO₂.
Quench Accutase with equal volume of D-MEM/F-12 and transfer cells to a labeled conical tube.
Transfer Accutase cell suspension into the appropriate conical using a P1000.
Count the total number of cells in each conical using a hemocytometer.
Centrifuge the cells at 200 × g for 5 min at 15°C–25°C.
Aspirate the supernatant and add 1 mL of 1% (wt/vol) PFA to each conical.
Resuspend the pellet using a P1000.
Incubate the cells at 15°C–25°C for 20 min to fix the cells.
Centrifuge the cells at 200 × g for 5 min at 15°C–25°C.
Aspirate the supernatant and resuspend cells in 1 mL/tube of ice cold 90% (vol/vol) methanol in water to allow permeabilization and analysis of intracellular targets.
Store samples at −20°C prior to antibody staining if necessary.
Aliquot 0.3–0.5 M cells in a 15 mL conical.
Label the conical tube appropriately.
Add 2 mL of Flow buffer 1 to each tube.
Centrifuge the cells at 200 × g for 5 min at 15°C–25°C.
Aspirate the supernatant and resuspend the pellet in 2 mL of Flow buffer 1.
Repeat the Flow buffer 1 wash.
Prepare 100 μL/sample of primary antibody solution in Flow buffer 2 according to the key resources table.
Aspirate the supernatant and resuspend the pellet in 100 μL of primary antibody solution.
Incubate samples at 15°C–25°C for 1 hour or at 4°C for 8 to 24 hours.
Add 2 mL of Flow buffer 1 to each tube after incubation.
Centrifuge the cells at 200 × g for 5 minutes at 15°C–25°C.
Prepare a secondary antibody solution in Flow buffer 2 according to the key resources table.
Aspirate the supernatant and resuspend the pellet in 100 μL of secondary antibody solution.
Incubate samples in the dark for at least 30 minutes at 15°C–25°C.
Add 2 mL of Flow buffer 2 to resuspend cells after aspirating the supernatant.
Centrifuge the cells at 200 × g for 5 minutes at 15°C–25°C.
Repeat the wash with Flow buffer 2.
Resuspend the cell pellet in 300 μL of Flow buffer 1 after aspirating the supernatant.
Transfer the samples to 5 mL flow cytometry round bottom tubes.
Keep the samples on ice until performing flow cytometry.
Analyze by flow cytometry according to instrument instructions.
Singularize cells using an Accutase lift.
Incubate undifferentiated hPSCs in Accutase for 5 minutes at 37°C, 5% CO2.
Incubate EpiCs in Accutase for 8 minutes at 37°C, 5% CO2.
Incubate EpiC-FBs in Accutase for 10 minutes at 37°C, 5% CO2.
Shake the plate and visually check if cells are lifting; add more Accutase if necessary.
Prepare a 15 mL conical tube for each sample with equal volume D-MEM/F-12 to volume Accutase used.
Label each conical tube appropriately.
Transfer the Accutase cell solution to the appropriate conical tubes using a P1000 pipette.
Centrifuge the cells at 200 × g for 5 minutes at 15°C–25°C.
Aspirate the supernatant.
Freeze the cell pellet at −80°C prior to mRNA extraction for at least 1 h.
Extract mRNA using a commercially available kit according to manufacturer’s instructions, including optional DNase treatment.
Clean gloves well using ELIMINase decontaminant.
Change pipette tips between every sample.
Quantify mRNA using Nanodrop spectrophotometer.
Store mRNA at −80°C.
Reverse transcribe 1,000 ng mRNA into cDNA using Omniscript Reverse Transcriptase kit and Oligo(dT)20 Primers according to manufacturer’s instructions.
Clean gloves well using ELIMINase decontaminant.
Dilute primers to 100 nM in DNA/RNA free water.
Prepare working aliquots of 10 μL 100 nM forward primer, 10 μL 100 nM reverse primer, and 180 μL DNA/RNA free water in a conical tube.
Store primers at −20°C.
Prepare reaction mixtures for qPCR with 1 μL primer mixture, 10.5 μL DNA/RNA free water, and 12.5 μL PowerUP Sybr Master Mix per desired reaction.
Pipette 24 μL of reaction mix into each well.
Add 1 μL of cDNA to the side of the well.
Store cDNA at −80°C until qPCR analysis.
Change pipette tips between every well.
Cover the qPCR plate with the cover seal.
Go over the cover with a scraper to ensure it is secure.
Centrifuge briefly at 50 × g for 10 seconds.
Turn on the qPCR machine and load the plate.
Run samples using the program shown in Table 3.
Store the qPCR plate at −20°C after performing qPCR.
Separate and visualize products on an agarose gel to verify product size if desired.
Average technical replicate Ct values for analysis.
Ensure there is less than a 0.5 Ct difference between technical replicates.
Check melting curves as part of quality control.
Quantify relative expression using ΔΔCt.
Perform appropriate statistical analysis.
Warm FibroGRO medium containing 2% FBS at 15°C–25°C for approximately 30 min.
Add 1 mL of Accutase to one well of a 6 well plate of day 10 EpiC-FB cells.
Incubate the plate at 37°C, 5% CO2 for 10 minutes.
Prepare quenching medium by adding 1 mL of FibroGRO medium containing 2% (vol/vol) FBS to a conical tube.
Harvest Accutase cell suspensions using a P1000 and combine the Accutase cell suspension with the quench medium.
Centrifuge the cells at 200 × g for 5 min at 15°C–25°C.
Label an uncoated 6 well tissue culture plate with hPSC line, hPSC passage number, EpiC passage number, EpiC-FB passage number, date, and initials.
Aspirate the supernatant from the conical tube.
Using a 10 mL pipette, resuspend the cell pellet in 12 mL of FibroGRO medium containing 2% (vol/vol) FBS.
Transfer 2 mL of cell solution to each well of the labelled 6 well tissue culture plate.
Return the plate to the 37°C, 5% CO2 incubator after plating the cells.
Move the plate in 3 quick, short, back-and-forth and side-to-side motions to disperse the cells across the surface of the wells.
Warm FibroGRO medium containing 2% (vol/vol) FBS and D-MEM/F-12 containing 10% (vol/vol) FBS at 15°C–25°C for approximately 30 min.
Prepare a conical tube containing 6 mL of D-MEM/F-12 containing 10% (vol/vol) FBS.
Add 40 μL of 15 μg/mL TGFβ1 to the conical tube.
Aspirate the medium from the EpiC-FBs.
Add 2 mL/well of FibroGRO to 3 wells.
Add 2 mL/well of D-MEM/F-12 containing 10% FBS and 100 ng/mL TGFβ1 to the remaining 3 wells.
Return the plate to the 37°C, 5% CO2 incubator.
